paper_title: Feedback Friction LLMs Struggle to Fully Incorporate External Feedback
caption: Comparison of the Improvement for 5-digit and 6-digit multiplication with as feedback model
model_annotation: The plot titled "Accuracy Improvement Over Iterations" illustrates the accuracy progression of two models—labeled "6-digit" and "5-digit"—over nine iterations. The x-axis, labeled "Iteration," ranges from 0 to 9 with a linear scale and integer tick marks at each unit. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy (%)," ranges from 0 to 100 with a linear scale and tick marks at intervals of 20. The "6-digit" model is represented by a blue line with circular markers, while the "5-digit" model is shown with an orange line and square markers. Both lines start at 0% accuracy at iteration 0. The "5-digit" model rises sharply to approximately 68% at iteration 1, then gradually increases to about 88% by iteration 9. The "6-digit" model begins to rise after iteration 1, reaching approximately 38% at iteration 2, then climbs more steadily to around 92% by iteration 9. After iteration 4, both lines plateau, with the "6-digit" model consistently achieving higher accuracy than the "5-digit" model.
